findings.where: 'Where we're starting' section: the Canggu, Uluwatu and Kuta Lombok destination cards, at desktop and phone
findings.fault: The cards have a thick purple border. Purple is not in the brand palette and has no job on the page. Card edges should be the thin sand-border (#EDE6D6) line. This is the strongest-coloured line on the page, and it puts a hue the brand never uses into the turquoise, sand and ink field.
findings.who_objects: The founder, whose rules give every colour exactly one job and give cards a 1–1.5px sand-border edge. A visitor who goes on to the destination guides and later the search would see cards in a colour that matches nothing else on the site. It reads as a different site or a leftover default, which undercuts the crafted feel the brand is selling.

findings.where: 'Where we're starting' section: the three destination cards, at desktop and phone
findings.fault: Each card sits on a large, soft drop shadow while at rest. The rules call for borders first and never a heavy shadow at rest. A shadow also tells the visitor 'you can act on this', but the parts map shows the cards themselves are static (they have a hover rule but are not links). The shadow promises a whole-card click that does nothing, and only the small 'Best hostels' line looks like a link. The rules also forbid pairing a border with a wide soft shadow on one resting element, and these cards do both.
findings.who_objects: A backpacker on a phone who taps the middle of a lifted card expecting to open the guide, and nothing happens. Also the founder, whose rules say nothing sits at rest under a heavy shadow.

findings.where: Hero: the coral 'Email … for launch news' button and the 'Explore destinations' outline button below it, at desktop and phone
findings.fault: The two buttons in the hero have different corners. The coral one is a full pill and the outline one is square-cornered. The rules set 8px corners for all controls. Placed one above the other, the mismatch makes them look like parts from two different kits rather than a primary and secondary action of one system.
findings.who_objects: The founder, whose rules set controls at 8px, keep pills for badges, tags and status chips, and say like surfaces are treated alike. A careful visitor sees an unfinished pairing at the very first screen.
